newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears SBI's GDR issue.
newsitem.headline: India clears SBI's GDR issue.

text.p: The Indian government said on Friday that it approved a proposal by the State Bank of India (SBI) to raise $500 million through global depositary receipts (GDRs).
Earlier on Friday, the state-owned bank said it planned to raise only $400 million through the issue.

The government said in a statement that the Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment approved SBI's proposal to raise the foreign currency resources for project and infrastructure finance and international banking requirements.
It said the GDR proceeds would be used to increase exposure in the areas of project and infrastructure finance, and meet growing international banking requirements.
